scripts.title: NHOOK | Manual Character Claim & Cutscene Skip
scripts.features:
· Character Catalogue: Browse all characters and lucky blocks, sorted by their rarity.
· Manual Claim: Instantly claim a specific character. You can do it once, repeat it, or claim it and turn into it.
· Batch Claim: Paste a list of names separated by commas, and it will claim them all.
· Auto-Farm: Automatically claims characters for you. You can set it to pick randomly, go for the rarest first, or avoid repeats.
· Filters: Tell the auto-farmer exactly what you want (Whitelist) or what to ignore (Blacklist).
· Custom Targets: Try to claim characters or skins that aren't in the normal list.
· Auto-Stop Limits: Set it and forget it. It can stop after a certain time, after X amount of tries, or once it successfully gets a character.
· Rarity Weights: Adjust the odds so the auto-farmer focuses more on Godly or Secret items.
· LandImpact / BlockLanded: Quick buttons to trigger these specific game events. You can even offset the position for LandImpact.
· Morph Helper: Force your character to show or hide a specific morph.
· Low-Graphics Mode: Turns off particles, lights, and shadows to boost your FPS (completely reversible).
· FPS Tools: Shows your FPS on screen and lets you cap your frame rate.
· Spam Protection: Adds a tiny delay between remote fires so the game server doesn't kick you for spamming.
